reason: Comment-only change (closes #1256): SQRT_SKIP_BAND's doc comment sized itself against 'the gap between the two square roots', but the shipped candidate loop has only one square root -- the two-roots framing is residue from a design rejected before it shipped. The rewrite replaces that rationale with the monotonicity argument (length() is sqrt() of the identical sub-expression length_squared() returns, and IEEE-754 sqrt is correctly rounded and therefore monotonic, so the squared guard is exact rather than merely well-padded). The constant's value, the guard, and every test are unchanged, so a recorded battle would be byte-identical to main's and would show nothing about the change. The behaviour this comment describes was verified against Godot's own source at 4.7-stable and re-checked empirically in-engine (2M probes straddling the band boundary: 0 monotonicity inversions, 0 pairs skipped that the exact test would call touching, worst-case margin ~419 float32 ULP).
